info.title: Mobula
info.description: FOSS control plane for Ray clusters. All endpoints take a Bearer JWT (OIDC). Note: the Ray Jobs API is NOT documented here — it is served by hostname, each registered cluster's hostname proxying Ray's own /api/jobs/ surface through the federating gateway. This spec covers Mobula's own control-plane routes.

get.summary: List every scoped role assignment, Admin-only.

put.summary:
Create or replace one assignment, Admin-only. The role and scope grammar
are validated here — the store is dumb persistence.

400.description: Unknown role or invalid scope grammar

delete.summary: Remove one assignment, Admin-only; 404 when the triple doesn't exist.

get.summary:
Effective role mappings for the access page. Admin-only. v1 is
read-only: with an OIDC validator the mappings come from the auth
config file; without one (local auth) `mappings` is null and roles are
managed per-user via `/api/v1/auth/users`.
List the persisted audit trail, Admin/Auditor-only (api-v1.md §5.9).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Only rows with `seq` strictly before this value (from a previous
response's `next_cursor`).

parameters.name: path_prefix
parameters.description: Rows whose path starts with this prefix.

parameters.name: min_status
parameters.description: Only rows with `status` >= this (status-less rows excluded).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` exports the page as `text/csv`; anything else is a 400.

200.description: Audit events, newest first. `?format=csv` returns text/csv instead.

400.description: Bad query (e.g. from > to, unknown format)

403.description: Admin or Auditor only — audit subjects are Admin data

get.summary: Replay the audit hash chain over a window, Admin/Auditor-only (#59).

parameters.name: from_seq
parameters.description:
First `seq` to check (default 1 — the whole trail from genesis).
The window chains from the newest preceding row's stored hash, so a
mid-trail window verifies against the same head it was written with.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Max rows to replay (default 100_000, clamped to 1_000_000). Trails
larger than one window verify in successive `from_seq` windows.

post.summary:
Username/password login (ADR-0011). Public (allowlisted); rate-limited
by bcrypt cost and the 5-strikes/5-minute account lockout.

200.description: Logged in; opaque bearer token returned

401.description: Invalid credentials (identical body for unknown user, wrong password, locked, or disabled)

post.summary:
Log out: if the caller authenticated with a PAT, revoke it; otherwise a
204 no-op (JWTs are stateless — there is nothing server-side to kill).

204.description: Logged out (PAT revoked when one was used)

get.summary: Login-page metadata: which providers are configured. Public by design.
List the caller's own tokens. Hashes are never serialized.

post.summary:
Mint a personal access token for the caller (ADR-0011). Any
authenticated identity; the plaintext is shown once.

delete.summary:
Revoke one of the caller's own tokens. Someone else's token (or a
nonexistent prefix) is a 404 — ownership can't be probed.

404.description: No such token for this caller

get.summary:
List all local users. Admin-only; hashes never serialize
([`LocalUserView`]).

200.description: All local users, ordered by username

post.summary:
Create a local user. Admin-only. 201 with the wire-safe view; 400 on a
bad username/short password; 409 when the username is taken.

400.description: Invalid username (RFC 1123) or password under 8 chars

201.description: Desired state recorded; reconciler will converge

202.description: Marked for termination; reconciler tears it down

200.description: The Ray head's Prometheus exposition, proxied verbatim

404.description: Metrics unavailable: the backend exposes no metrics endpoint for this cluster

502.description: The Ray head could not be reached or its response exceeded the 4MiB cap

202.description: Desired state set back to running; reconciler re-provisions (suspend=false)

409.description: Illegal state transition, or the cluster's project is queue-assigned (Kueue owns suspend)

202.description: Desired state set to suspended; reconciler releases compute (spec.suspend=true)

409.description: Illegal state transition, or the cluster's project is queue-assigned (Kueue owns suspend)

get.summary:
"Who am I": the resolved identity for any authenticated caller. In dev
mode (no validator AND no local auth) the auth middleware attaches no
identity, and this returns the specced dev identity so the
unauthenticated dev loop renders the full console.

200.description: The caller's identity (the dev identity when auth is disabled)

401.description: No/invalid token (only when auth is configured)

200.description: Prometheus text exposition of usage and control-plane gauges

400.description: Invalid spec (bad name, no flavors, unparseable quantity)

409.description: Pool already exists (create-only in v0; spec update lands with a later PATCH)

400.description: Invalid allocation, or body pool/project mismatches the path

403.description: Admin only — the registry is the credential-routing table

202.description: Deploy accepted; KubeRay rolls it out

get.summary:
The effective governance policy. Admin-only: quotas and prices are
platform configuration (api-v1.md §2.2), classified with `Target::Cluster`
like the registry/audit surfaces.

200.description: The effective policy and its provenance

403.description: Admin only — governance is platform configuration

put.summary:
Replace sections of the governance policy. Admin-only. Edits take effect
on the very next request — quota admission, cost estimates, and the usage
roll-up all read the store per request. Emits an `update_policy` audit
event on success.

200.description: The policy after the update (source is now "store")

403.description: Admin only — governance is platform configuration

200.description: Resource-hours (and cost when priced) by project and pool

AllocationSpec.description:
A project's allocation within a pool (translates to a Kueue LocalQueue).

`nominal` / `borrowing_limit` / `lending_limit` are reserved for a future
per-project ClusterQueue layout (ADR-0010): in the v0 layout all
allocations in a pool share one ClusterQueue, so these are recorded as
LocalQueue annotations rather than enforced quotas.

ApiTokenView.description: The public projection of an API token — no hash, no plaintext.

AssignmentView.description: One assignment as the wire sees it.

created_at.description: Unix seconds when the assignment was first written.

principal.description: The Identity `subject` the assignment applies to.

AuditDecision.description:
Whether Mobula allowed or refused the thing the event describes.
Serialized snake_case (`allow` / `deny`).

AuditEvent.description:
One audit-trail row (api-v1.md §5.9). Fields not applicable to the
emitting site are `None` (serialized `null`); `granted_roles` is empty.

Decision policy (mobula-api `audit` module): `deny` rows are emitted at
the point of refusal (authn failures, authz denials, quota denials);
gateway per-request rows are always `allow` — a request Mobula refuses
never reaches the gateway, so its `deny` row comes from the refuser.

cluster.description: Cluster id the event concerns; `null` when not cluster-scoped.

granted_roles.description: Roles the caller held (snake_case); authz denials only, else `[]`.

method.description: HTTP method, for gateway and authn/ext_authz rows.

oneOf.description: The permission an authz denial was checked against.

status.description: HTTP status of the outcome, when one is known.

subject.description: Authenticated subject; `null` for authn failures (no identity yet).

AuditListResponse.description:
Response of `GET /api/v1/audit`. This endpoint is the ONE list route
that wraps its items in an envelope — the cursor has to live somewhere
(api-v1.md §5.9).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next (older) page; `null` at the end.

AuditRequired.description:
The (verb, target) permission an authorization decision was checked
against — mirrors `mobula_auth::{PermissionType, Target}` as lowercase
strings (`"write"`, `"cluster"`) so core stays free of auth types.
Present only on authz denials.

events_checked.description:
Rows that verified before the replay stopped (the whole window on
success; the rows before the broken one on failure).

first_broken_seq.description:
Seq of the first row whose stored `chain_hash` doesn't match the
replay; `null` when the window verifies clean.

ok.description: True when every row in the window matched the replayed chain.

ClusterSpec.description:
Declarative spec for a managed Ray cluster.

v0 targets the KubeRay backend only; fields deliberately mirror what maps
onto a RayCluster CR so the provisioner stays a thin translation.

ttl_seconds.description: Idle TTL in seconds; `None` disables reaping.

ClusterState.description: Lifecycle states of a managed cluster (PLAN.md §3.1).

ClusterView.description:
A cluster as the control plane sees it: desired spec metadata plus the
last observed state (reconstructed from the provisioner, ADR-0006).

condition.description:
Drift/health alarm raised by the reconcile engine (ADR-0004, #41/#47):
"spec_drift" (out-of-band edit) or "degraded". `None` when converging
normally. Distinct from `observed_state`.

est_min_hourly.description: Estimated $/hr at min size, if a price sheet is configured.

generation.description: Bumps when the spec changes; drives the reconcile idempotency key.

observed_state.description: Observed lifecycle state, if the cluster has been reconciled.

CreateCluster.description: Request body for creating/updating a managed cluster.

id.description: Stable cluster id (also the gateway routing key / RayCluster name).

CreatePool.description: Request body for creating a pool.

expires_in_days.description: Lifetime in days; capped at the server maximum (90).

CreateTokenResponse.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/tokens` success body. The plaintext `token` is
returned ONLY here — store it now; it cannot be recovered.

password.description:
Minimum 8 characters; bcrypt-hashed at rest, never stored or
returned in plaintext.

DeployService.description: Request body to deploy or update a service.

FlavorSpec.description:
A hardware flavor within a pool: node selection plus per-resource
nominal quota (K8s quantity strings, e.g. "4", "512Gi").

resources.description: Resource key → nominal quota quantity string.

JobView.description: A job in the persistent, cross-cluster history (Phase 3, spec §5.5).

duration_secs.description: Wall-clock seconds once terminal; null while running.

status.description: Ray job status (PENDING | RUNNING | SUCCEEDED | FAILED | STOPPED).

LocalRole.description:
A local user's role (ADR-0011: roles are a column on the user, resolved
per request — no claim staleness). Stored as TEXT in `local_users.role`;
the vocabulary mirrors `mobula_auth::Role` (kept as a separate enum so
core never depends on the auth crate).

LocalUserView.description:
The public projection of a local user — everything EXCEPT the password
hash and the lockout internals that are nobody else's business.

LoginIdentity.description: The identity half of a login response.

LoginResponse.description:
`POST /api/v1/auth/login` success body. `token` is an opaque
`mob_…` bearer credential (ADR-0011: stored, never signed).

expires_at.description: Unix seconds after which the token no longer authenticates.

PolicyView.description:
`GET /api/v1/settings/policy` response: the effective policy plus its
provenance.

editable.description: Always true in v1 — the policy is editable via PUT.

prices.description: resource → $/unit-hour; `null` when no price sheet is configured.

quotas.description: project → (resource → limit). Empty when no quotas are configured.

source.description:
"file" (the untouched `--policy` boot seed) | "store" (edited via
PUT) | "none" (no policy configured at all).

PoolSpec.description: A shared capacity pool: flavors + a cohort to borrow from (ADR-0010).

cohort.description:
Name of the Kueue cohort this pool's ClusterQueue joins for elastic
borrowing.

elastic.description:
Whether workloads in this pool may be elastically resized (Kueue
elastic jobs / Workload Slices).

PoolUsageView.description:
Live point-in-time usage of one pool (Slice 4): built from the pool's
latest stored ClusterQueue/LocalQueue observation plus the spec's
nominal quotas. NOT a timeseries — for history use `GET /api/v1/usage`.
`projects` is the per-LocalQueue (per-project) attribution; empty when
the observation predates per-LQ status or none exists.

sampled_at.description:
When the observation was recorded (unix seconds); `null` until the
pool reconcile loop has observed this pool.

PoolView.description:
A pool as the control plane serves it: the stored spec metadata plus
`total_nominal`, the per-resource sum of all flavors' nominal quotas.

generation.description: Bumps when the spec changes (same convention as clusters).

total_nominal.description:
Resource key → summed nominal quota across flavors, as a string.
A resource key whose quantity fails to parse on ANY flavor is
omitted entirely (a partial sum would misreport capacity); the
failure is logged. Display math only — the spec stays authoritative.

ProvidersResponse.description:
Which auth providers this deployment offers (login-page metadata; not
sensitive — the endpoint is public by design).

oneOf.description: OIDC configuration, when a validator is configured.

PutAllocation.description:
Request body for putting an allocation: `AllocationSpec` minus
`pool`/`project`, which come from the path. If the body still carries
them, they must match the path or the request is rejected.

RegistryEntryView.description:
A gateway routing entry as the control plane may show it: where a
cluster is exposed and where its dashboard head lives, but never the
token itself (ADR-0003, security issue #4).

token_set.description: Whether the gateway holds a static Ray token for this cluster.

oneOf.description:
Reserved for per-entry validation/reachability checks. Always null
today: registry validation is fail-fast at startup, so every served
entry is valid by construction.

RegistryValidation.description: Placeholder shape for future per-entry health/validation results.

ResourceUtilization.description:
One resource's live utilization within a pool: `allocated` is the Kueue
reservation-ledger total (summed across flavors from the latest
ClusterQueue observation), `nominal` the summed flavor quotas from the
spec, `pct` = allocated / nominal × 100 (0 when nominal is 0 — a
percentage of nothing is undefined, and 0 keeps the type non-optional).

RoleMappingsView.description:
Group→role mappings from the OIDC auth config; shape mirrors
`mobula_auth::RoleMappings` (a wire twin so `mobula-auth` stays free of
serialization/api deps).

RolesResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/access/roles` response. `mappings` is null when no OIDC
validator is configured (local-auth or dev mode): group→role mappings
are meaningless there — local users carry their role as a column.

editable.description: Always false in v1 — editing stays in the config file + restart.

source.description:
"file" (mappings from the OIDC auth config) or "local" (no OIDC
validator; roles live on the local user rows).

ServiceSpec.description: Declarative spec for a managed Serve service.

serve_config_v2.description:
The Serve application config (KubeRay `serveConfigV2`), passed
through verbatim as a YAML string — Mobula does not interpret it.

worker_replicas.description:
Fixed worker replicas backing the service (autoscaling of Serve
deployments is Ray Serve's own concern).

state.description: Observed lifecycle state: provisioning | running | updating | ...

url.description: External Serve endpoint base URL, when ready.

UpdatePolicy.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/v1/settings/policy`. Section-replace
semantics: a present key replaces that whole section (`prices: null`
clears the price sheet; `quotas: {}` clears all quotas); an absent key
leaves that section untouched.

prices.description: Present (incl. explicit `null`) replaces/clears the price sheet.

quotas.description: Present replaces the whole quota map (`{}` clears all quotas).

password.description: New password (min 8 chars); replaces the bcrypt hash.

UpgradeStrategy.description: How to roll out a new version of a service.

UsageGroup.description: One (project, pool) group of the usage report.

cost_usd.description: Total cost in USD; `null` when no price sheet is configured.

pool.description: Empty string = the project has no allocation.

project.description: Empty string = the pool-level aggregate row (Kueue path only).

WorkerGroup.description:
A homogeneous group of Ray worker nodes.

Autoscaling in v0 is actuated exclusively through these replica bounds,
which translate to KubeRay worker-group fields — never by reading demand
from GCS (ADR-0002).

tags.name: clusters
tags.description: Cluster lifecycle. Reads need any authenticated role; create/terminate need Write on the cluster target (Operator or Admin). Mounted only when the lifecycle controller is enabled (`serve --kuberay-namespace`).

tags.name: services
tags.description: Ray Serve services (RayService). Deploy/update/delete need Write on the service target (Developer or Admin — deploying is code); reads are open to any authenticated role. KubeRay handles zero-downtime canary rollout.

tags.name: pools
tags.description: Capacity pools and per-project allocations (ADR-0010): platform configuration, not app lifecycle. Reads need any authenticated role; create/delete/allocation mutations are Admin-only. Mounted only when a store is configured.

tags.name: usage
tags.description: Usage metering (Slice 4): resource-hours reports and the Prometheus gauge over the metered samples. Reads need Read on the cluster target (Viewer+) — consumption reporting is cluster data, not pool topology. Mounted only when a store is configured.

tags.name: settings
tags.description: Governance policy management (api-v1.md §5.16): the effective price sheet and per-project quotas. Admin-only. The `--policy` file is the boot-time default; the store row wins once edited via PUT, and every consumer (quota admission, cost estimates, usage roll-up) reads the store per request, so edits apply without a restart. Mounted only when a store is configured.

tags.name: registry
tags.description: The job gateway's routing table (ADR-0002). Admin-only: it is the credential-routing table. Static config today; dynamic registration of managed clusters is a follow-up.

tags.name: audit
tags.description: The persisted audit trail (api-v1.md §5.9): every authn/authz decision, mutation, and proxied gateway request, newest-first with seq-cursor pagination and CSV export. Rows are hash-chained for tamper-evidence (#59); `audit/verify` replays the chain. Reads need Read on the audit target — Admin or Auditor — and are themselves audited (`audit_read` rows). Mounted only when a store is configured.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Local auth (ADR-0011): username/password login issuing opaque (unsigned) bearer tokens, personal access token management, provider metadata, and Admin-only local user management. `login` and `providers` are public; token routes are owner-scoped; user routes are Admin-only. Mounted only with `serve --local-auth` (except `providers`).

tags.name: access
tags.description: Identity & access (api-v1.md §5.8): `identity` is 'who am I' for any authenticated caller (the dev identity when auth is disabled); `access/roles` is the Admin-only read of the effective role mappings. Mounted unconditionally.
